User.title: Telegram User Profile
User.description: Public profile of a USDT Mining Telegram user, identified by their Telegram ID

id.description: The Telegram User ID as string

referralsCount.description: Number of users referred by this user

earnedReferralCoins.description: Number of referral coins earned by this user

claimedMilestones.description: List of milestones claimed by this user

totalEarned.description: Total USDT earned (scaled or raw decimal)

lastActive.description: Server timestamp of last active session sync

Referral.title: Referral Relationship
Referral.description: Record of a successful referral invitation linking the referrer and referred user

id.description: Document ID, which is the referred user's ID

referrerId.description: The Telegram ID of the user who made the invitation

referredUserId.description: The Telegram ID of the newly joined user

referredName.description: The first name/display name of the newly joined user

referredUsername.description: The username of the newly joined user

rewardCoins.description: Referral coins rewarded to the referrer

users/{userId}.description: User profiles indexed by their Telegram User ID

referrals/{referralId}.description: Referrals registry indexed by the referred user's ID
